summary: Busy parked kerb on Upland Road, but homes sit 12-25 m behind it.
reasons: Homes about 12-25 m back on this side

drivers.seclusion: Houses and an office building face the kerb across short front gardens, roughly 12-25 m away; the south side is a car park and a lawn.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide road with a row of cars parked along the north kerb; room for a van among them.
drivers.traffic: Through road near the university, busy by day; quieter overnight.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; signs ban parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm only, so nights are clear.

flags: No Parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm signs: leave before 7am on weekdays
Homes 8-12 m away at 14-24 m and 99 m, outside the best section
Road noise from a through route
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees give patchy shade from the north side.
cannot_judge: Exact weekend rules, signs do not give a time for every one

best_section.where: Upland Road north kerb, opposite the university car park entrance
